# ataila_tenants (Data Source)

Every tenant on the platform, or every tenant of one customer, in slug order. The provider reads every page of the list.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "ataila_customer" "example" {
  short_name = "EXAMPLE"
}

# Every tenant of one customer; omit customer_id for every tenant on the platform.
data "ataila_tenants" "example" {
  customer_id = data.ataila_customer.example.id
}

output "tenant_slugs" {
  value = [for t in data.ataila_tenants.example.tenants : t.slug]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `customer_id` (String) Only this customer's tenants. Omit it for all tenants, legacy tenants without a customer included.

### Read-Only

- `tenants` (Attributes List) The tenants, ordered by slug. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tenants))

<a id="nestedatt--tenants"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tenants`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) When the tenant was created, as the platform reports it.
- `customer_id` (String) Id of the customer the tenant belongs to. **Frozen.** Null only for a legacy tenant that no customer owns.
- `default_router_id` (String) Id of the tenant's default VPN router. Omit it to leave the platform's choice (a customer's primary tenant gets the hub router; a new tenant gets none). Once set it can be changed but not cleared from configuration.
- `description` (String) Description, up to 2000 characters.
- `id` (String) Tenant id (a UUID), assigned by the platform.
- `is_primary` (Boolean) Whether this is a customer's primary tenant, created with the customer. A primary tenant is never deleted.
- `member_count` (Number) Tenant memberships.
- `name` (String) Display name, 2-120 characters.
- `project_count` (Number) Projects in the tenant, every status included.
- `slug` (String) Slug, `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,29}$`, unique across the platform; it names the tenant's groups and paths. **Frozen.**
- `updated_at` (String) When the tenant was last changed, as the platform reports it.
